liquidate(address,(address,address,uint2.details: Anyone may trigger the liquidation of an underwater position. The hook      validates the position is actually liquidatable and enforces slippage      via minAmountOut, so permissionless access cannot force bad liquidations.

params.minAmountOut: Minimum swap output for the liquidation unwind (slippage                     protection against MEV); derive it from an oracle quote.

owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

rebalance(address,(address,address,uint2.details: Re-centers an out-of-range position's concentrated liquidity around the      current tick. Safe to run permissionless: it only moves liquidity ranges,      is a no-op when the tick is already in range, and the caller pays gas.

renounceOwnership().details: Leaves the contract without owner. It will not be possible to call `onlyOwner` functions. Can only be called by the current owner. NOTE: Renouncing ownership will leave the contract without an owner, thereby disabling any functionality that is only available to the owner.

transferOwnership(address).details: Transfers ownership of the contract to a new account (`newOwner`). Can only be called by the current owner.

quoteExactInput((address,address,uint24,.notice: Quoter-to-execution parity view helper for ODOS/Enso aggregators. Returns 0 cleanly without throwing EVM reverts on invalid input.
